title: What is the current debt situation in the EU?
subtitle: The EU's average government debt-to-GDP ratio increased slightly from 80.5% to 80.7% as of the end of Q3 2025.
textNote:
The following countries do not comply with the Maastricht criterion of a maximum government debt of 60% of GDP:
Belgium, Germany, Greece, Spain, France, Italy, Cyprus, Hungary, Austria, Portugal, Slovenia, Slovakia, Finland.
